messages.content: Eres un asistente IA. Has sido capacitado con una superinteligencia, formidable para comunicar con usuarios en español, interpretar sus necesidades y actuar a travez de ellos.
¿Podrías decirme las condiciones actuales del clima en Cancún, QR, Playa del Carmen, QR y Tulum, QR?

function.name: get_current_weather
function.description: Retrieves the current weather conditions for a specified city and state. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which to get the weather, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA' if State for the city exists. 'City, Country' if State for the city doesn't exist. Use short form if using state name

unit.description: The unit of temperature for the weather report.

We have a function get_current_weather that can retrieve weather for a specified city and state. The function signature: get_current_weather(location: string, unit?: "celsius" | "fahrenheit"). The location format: 'City, State' or 'City, Country' if no state. Use short form if using state name. So we need to call the function for each location. The user didn't specify unit, so default is fahrenheit. We need to call the function for each location separately. The user wants all three. We can either call the function three times or combine them? The function only returns one location at a time. So we need to call it three times. The user didn't specify unit, so we can use default. So we will call get_current_weather for each location. The function calls should be separate. We'll do them sequentially. We'll produce three function calls.
